How we build a YouTube video in three days or less. Alex approves every step.
See our work: https://ka-performancefl.com/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-10-16

Behind the scenes of our first long YouTube video, "Test your website with one key":

Before day 1: a plan and a brief. The topic, the page it links to and a three-day schedule are written down, and Alex approves them before anything is made.
Day 1: captures, voice and music. The screen captures are our own site, and every bad example is a plain test page we built for the video. The voice is AI narrated, one file per beat, and every take is checked against the script.
Day 2: the edit. Style frames first, then the cut, with our logo and web address on every frame.
Day 3: render, then Alex approves it on our Post Desk. Only then is it scheduled.

Full walkthrough on our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@KAPerformancefl

Want help with your own website? Call Alex at 904-210-1071 or message us here.

The voice in the video is AI narrated. The music in this reel is AI generated.

#GainesvilleFL #SmallBusiness #BehindTheScenes
